title: EPD
description: An Environmental Product Declaration (ISO 14025 with ISO 21930 or EN 15804): the declaration's identity, its declared unit and the product's GWP for modules A1-A3.

x-reviera.instructions: Values of the product this EPD declares, as printed. Give numbers as printed in the results table and dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

manufacturer.description: The company that makes the declared product

epd_number.description: The EPD's declaration or registration number

declared_unit.description: The declared or functional unit the results are given per, as printed, for example 1 m2 or 1,000 ft2

gwp_a1a3.description: GWP-total for modules A1-A3 combined, in kg CO2 eq per declared unit; where several are given, the IPCC AR6 (or EN 15804+A2) GWP-total including biogenic carbon
